summary: Ran the report on every commit between v2.3.0 and v2.4.0 and found 9a04783 is the first that gives the 2.4.0 totals, and every later one does too. Its change to parse_stamp in tally/dates.py converts offsets to UTC, which moves rows to other booking days; the earliest tag containing it is v2.4.0rc1.
